_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Yɛ̀rɛ la Player {player_id} kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ {num_players} la Liar's Dice kɛlɛ.
Kɛ̀rɛ:
- Yɛ̀rɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ, yɛ̀ kɛ̀rɛ:
  1) Kʋ̀rɛ kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ kʋ̀rɛ kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kɛ̀rɛ kɛlɛ yɛ̀rɛ '[Call]'.

Yɛ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ:
  - Yɛ̀rɛ kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ kʋ̀rɛ kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ, kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ kʋ̀rɛ kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ dɛ̀ɛ̀ kʋ̀ŋɛ.
  - Kɛ̀rɛ kɛlɛ, kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ dɛ̀ɛ̀ kʋ̀ŋɛ.
Kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ 0 dɛ̀ɛ̀ kʋ̀ŋɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ. Kɛlɛ pʋ̀ʋ̀rɛ kɛ̀rɛ wɛ̀rɛ yɛ̀rɛ nɛ̀ kʋ̀rɛ kɛlɛ.

board.new_round:
Kɛlɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ - Dice kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ: {dice_summary}
Yɛrɛ Dice kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kɔlɛ! Face {face_value} kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ {count}, yɛrɛ LESS kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ bidder) kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kɔlɛ! Face {face_value} kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ {count}, yɛrɛ >= kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (kɔlɛrɛ) kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: B sẽn bool-a wã pa yɩ ne ligd ye.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Kɛlɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ yɛrɛ '[Bid: X, Y]' yɛrɛ '[Call]'. Kɛlɛ wɛɛlɛ: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Face kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {new_face_value} yɛrɛ kɔmɔgɔ wɛɛlɛ {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: B sẽn kõ ligd ningã zemsa ne b sẽn da kõt rũnda wã.
